BALI TOURISM BOARD · WEBSITE DEMONSTRATION
The island of the gods

Welcome to
BTB/GIPI BALI

The Bali Tourism Board (BTB) brings together tourism stakeholders to promote Bali, its cultural heritage, and the extraordinary experiences the island has to offer.

Connecting travelers, the tourism industry, and local communities, we celebrate a destination shaped by nature, culture, and warm hospitality.

Discover Bali with respect for its people and a shared commitment to responsible tourism.

People behind the destination

Ida Bagus Agung
Partha Adnyana

Chairman of Bali Tourism Board

Known as Gus Agung, Ida Bagus Agung Partha Adnyana is featured on the Bali Tourism Board website as its chairman, with a focus on Bali’s cultural identity and the development of quality tourism.

Key Focus

Supporting tourism that benefits local communities, preserves cultural traditions, and protects Bali’s natural environment.

Travel Advice to Bali

Bali: A Living Paradise

From temple architecture and living traditions to rice terraces and coastal landscapes, Bali offers a journey through nature and culture.

Explore the island at your own pace, meet its communities, and make room for experiences that go beyond the familiar.

A Destination for Every Journey

  • Nature — rice terraces, waterfalls, and mountain landscapes.
  • Culture — temples, village traditions, art, and performances.
  • Culinary — local flavors and Bali’s rich food heritage.
  • Wellness — time to slow down and reconnect.

Explore with care

Respect local customs and follow instructions at temples, beaches, and natural attractions. Use trusted transport providers and check current conditions before outdoor activities.

Keep personal belongings secure and confirm meeting points, travel arrangements, and operator contact details before departure.

Useful emergency contacts

  • 110 — Police.
  • 119 — Medical emergency assistance.
  • 115 — Search and rescue, Basarnas.

Call the relevant service directly in an emergency. This demonstration website does not dispatch assistance.

Prepare for your journey

Discuss your personal travel needs with a qualified health professional. Bring your prescribed medication and relevant travel insurance information.

Choose safe drinking water, take breaks in the heat, and use appropriate protection against sun and mosquito exposure.

When you need help

Seek a qualified healthcare provider if you feel unwell. For urgent medical assistance, contact 119 and describe your location and situation to the operator.

General travel information only. Availability of facilities and services should be confirmed directly.
